note: UK-eligible EIT (European Institute of Innovation and Technology) KIC open calls only. EIT is Horizon Europe Pillar 3 and funds through sector Knowledge & Innovation Communities (KICs), each running its own calls on its own site; there is no public API, so this dataset is curated like the Eureka one. A call is included only when UK organisations are eligible, confirmed against each call's official manual and the EC list of Horizon Europe participating countries (V4.2, 07.10.2026: the United Kingdom is associated to the entire Programme, so UK entities participate under conditions equivalent to EU Member States). EIT calls that are published on the EU Funding & Tenders portal (identifiers beginning HORIZON-EIT-, including the KIC framework-partnership/business-activity grants and the European Prize for Women Innovators) are deliberately excluded: they are already ingested by the Horizon Europe source and must not be duplicated here. Refresh by re-pulling the EIT opportunities hub and each KIC site and updating this file; the capture date is shown on every card.

calls.title: EIT Higher Education Initiative (HEI) Call for Proposals 2026
calls.summary: The cross-KIC EIT Higher Education Initiative funds consortia that build innovation and entrepreneurship capacity in higher education. A project needs at least five funded partners, including at least three higher education institutions from three different Horizon Europe-eligible countries (one an EU Member State) plus at least two business or industry partners.

calls.title: SME Market Expansion Open Call 2027
calls.summary: A mono-beneficiary call from EIT Urban Mobility for SMEs that are supported by an end client, helping them bring an urban-mobility solution to a new market. Each selected SME receives a fixed lump sum of EUR 60,000. SMEs must be registered in an EU Member State or a country associated with Horizon Europe, which includes the United Kingdom.

calls.title: New Ventures in Creative Tech (Spark)
calls.summary: An EIT Culture & Creativity incubation call for early-stage founders, individuals or small multidisciplinary teams with a creative-technology venture concept and no registered company yet. Selected ventures receive up to EUR 30,000 and must incorporate a legal entity during the programme. Applicants must be based in an EU Member State or a country officially associated with Horizon Europe, which includes the United Kingdom.

calls.title: Proof of Concept & Technology Validation Call
calls.summary: An EIT Food Biotech Alliance call for agrifood and biotech start-ups to validate technology, with a Route 1 proof-of-concept track (TRL 4-6) and a Route 2 demonstrator track (TRL 7-9). Any legal entity is eligible to participate regardless of its place of establishment, so UK start-ups can apply; grant size is set per route rather than as a single published amount.
